text:
Jonathan Lekkerimäki is the most fun thing happening in Vancouver right now. The 22-year-old, picked 15th in 2022, has seven goals and 15 points in 20 games after managing three points in 13 games last season, and he scored again in Monday's loss to Philadelphia ("a perfectly placed shot," per Daniel Wagner of Pass it to Bulis). Canucks Army's headline caught the mood: "He’s got that swagger."

For context, forwards drafted 10th to 20th since 2005 scored a median 0.35 points a game in their first full season. He's at 0.75. Some of that is hot shooting: seven goals on 4.1 expected, 19%, which tends to settle. But the chances are genuinely there, eight of his points have come on the power play, and Yahoo Sports' lineup notes had him skating with Elias Pettersson and Brock Boeser against the Flyers. By our wins-added measure his goals have swung games more than most (44th of 521 skaters). He isn't a burner (his top speed is in the 10th percentile); his weapon is the release. The question for the rest of the year is how much of the finish holds once teams adjust.
headline: Lekkerimäki's breakout is the bright spot in Vancouver
